  {"step":7,"file":"src/bele_policy.h","function":"LEPolicy::get64","line":173,"var":"p","code":"V upx_uint64_t get64(const void *p) C { return get_le64(p); }","note":"The little-endian policy performs no bounds validation and forwards the pointer to the raw 64-bit load helper."},
